QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] Finding the Lost Ones
QuestInfo.0: You can't get out. You can't find anyone. This seems more hopeless by the second. What will you do?
QuestInfo.1: The sound of people screaming carries to you through the labyrinth. It could be another one of Hilla's tricks, but if there's even a chance that it's real, you have to help. Go through the door on the right.
